tools.name: list_websites
tools.description: Every website this connection can use (one or several, chosen by the user in Kiescy): its id, name, address, health score and open issues by severity. Other tools take one of these as "website".

tools.name: get_document_setup
tools.description: The starting point for legal documents. Returns the business profile collected so far, the next setup questions, the documents this business needs (with the best template and the legal reason), and the state of existing documents.

tools.name: update_business_profile
tools.description: Saves answers to the setup questions (ids from get_document_setup). Only the answers passed are saved; unknown ones can be left out. Contact details also update the site's Business information.

tools.name: list_document_templates
tools.description: The template library: for each document type, the available templates, what makes each different, who it's for and which jurisdictions it focuses on.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Every document type for this website with its status (none, draft, published, changed = published with unpublished edits), review stage, template, version, live URL and whether a review is due.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: One document in full: its content as Markdown, every question with its current answer (significant ones show whether the user confirmed them), unanswered questions, and findings (missing topics, outdated clauses, duplicates).

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Creates a draft from a template (see list_document_templates), pre-filled from the business profile. Does nothing if the document already exists. Doesn't publish.

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Changes a draft and saves a new version (never publishes). Set answers (only the ones you change), switch template, or replace the text with your own Markdown (for imported or custom documents). Significant answers are refused until you pass the user's explicit confirmation in `confirmed`. Returns w

tools.name: import_document
tools.description: Reads the user's existing document from a public URL, pasted text, or a file (base64; PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown or TXT, up to 8 MB). Returns its outline, facts found (emails, return periods, governing law), suggested answers and findings (missing topics, outdated clauses). Saves nothing to the docum

tools.name: apply_import
tools.description: use=keep: the document becomes the imported text (own text, as a new draft version) so you can improve it while keeping its wording. use=answers: creates or updates the generated document using answers found in the import; significant ones are returned for the user to confirm instead of being applie

tools.name: analyze_document
tools.description: Checks a saved document, or any text you pass, for missing topics (for the business's jurisdictions), outdated clauses, duplicate paragraphs and unconfirmed significant answers. Findings cite the legal basis when they're requirements; others are suggestions.

tools.name: check_documents
tools.description: Site-wide review: inconsistencies between documents (contact details, return periods, governing law, age limits, cookies vs. privacy answers), documents the business needs but hasn't published, documents due for review, unpublished changes and documents awaiting approval.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: A document's versions, newest first: who made each (dashboard user or assistant), when, why, what changed, and which one is live.

tools.name: compare_versions
tools.description: Differences between two versions: changed answers and added/removed lines. Use "live" for the published version and "current" for the draft.

tools.name: preview_document
tools.description: Renders what a document would look like with different answers, template or text, without saving anything. Returns Markdown and the findings for that version.

tools.name: publish_document
tools.description: Two steps. 1) Call without confirmation_token: returns what will change, warnings and a one-time token (valid 15 minutes, for this exact version). 2) Called again with that token, it publishes. The server instructions require the user's explicit yes between the two calls. If the site requires approv

tools.name: rollback_document
tools.description: Restores an older version as the current draft (doesn't publish). Needs user_confirmed: the user asked for this restore.

tools.name: mark_document_reviewed
tools.description: Records that the user reviewed a document and it's still correct, and schedules the next review reminder.

tools.name: save_translation
tools.description: Saves a translation of a document (Markdown) as a draft. Translate from the current published version, keep the structure and headings, and don't change the meaning. Publish it with publish_document and `language`. Languages: es, fr, de, it, pt, nl, pl, sv, da, fi, no, cs, ro, hu, el, tr, ja, ko, zh

tools.name: get_embed_code
tools.description: How to show the published documents on the user's website: the embed script, hosted URLs, and ready-made snippets for HTML, React, Next.js, WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix and Squarespace. Also lists the pages where the embed was seen working.

tools.name: update_document_style
tools.description: Changes how this site's documents look (hosted pages, embeds and exports). Start from one of 62 ready-made designs (design: clean = Clean, Simple single column with a contents box; swiss = Swiss, Huge title, strict grid, numbered sections; monochrome = Monochrome, Black, white and nothing else; airy

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_documents" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "documents" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_websites, list_documents, check_documents, get_embed_code, update_document_style · Private data: get_document_setup, update_business_profile, list_document_templates, list_documents, get_document, create_document, update_document, import_document, apply_import, analyze_document, check_documents, list_versions, preview_document, publish_document, rollback_document, mark_document_reviewed, save_translation, get_embed_code, update_document_style · Public sink: create_document, publish_document, rollback_document, save_translation · Destructive: update_document_style.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_websites, list_documents, check_documents, get_embed_code, update_document_style · Private data: get_document_setup, update_business_profile, list_document_templates, list_documents, get_document, create_document, update_document, import_document, apply_import, analyze_document, check_documents, list_versions, preview_document, publish_document, rollback_document, mark_document_reviewed, save_translation, get_embed_code, update_document_style · Public sink: create_document, publish_document, rollback_document, save_translation · Destructive: update_document_style

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
